title: Monster reading a book
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Monster body -->
  <ellipse cx='42' cy='70' rx='28' ry='24' fill='#59d96e'/>
  <!-- Lighter belly -->
  <ellipse cx='42' cy='75' rx='17' ry='15' fill='#a8f5b0'/>
  <!-- Monster head -->
  <circle cx='42' cy='38' r='24' fill='#4ccc62'/>
  <!-- Horns -->
  <path d='M28 20 Q24 6 32 14 Q30 18 34 22 Z' fill='#f5d442'/>
  <path d='M56 20 Q60 6 52 14 Q54 18 50 22 Z' fill='#f5d442'/>
  <!-- Eyes -->
  <circle cx='34' cy='35' r='7' fill='#fff9c4'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='35' r='7' fill='#fff9c4'/>
  <circle cx='35' cy='36' r='4' fill='#2a1a4a'/>
  <circle cx='51' cy='36' r='4' fill='#2a1a4a'/>
  <circle cx='36' cy='34' r='1.5' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='52' cy='34' r='1.5' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- Mouth -->
  <path d='M34 46 Q42 54 50 46' stroke='#2a1a4a' stroke-width='2.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Little teeth -->
  <path d='M37 46 L38 50 L40 46 Z' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <path d='M44 46 L45 50 L47 46 Z' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- Arms holding book -->
  <path d='M20 62 Q12 58 16 68 Q20 72 26 68' fill='#4ccc62' stroke='#3aaa4e' stroke-width='2'/>
  <path d='M64 62 Q72 58 68 68 Q64 72 58 68' fill='#4ccc62' stroke='#3aaa4e' stroke-width='2'/>
  <!-- Book -->
  <g>
    <!-- Left page -->
    <path d='M26 60 L46 56 L46 78 L26 82 Z' fill='#fff3d6' stroke='#e8c88a' stroke-width='1.5'/>
    <!-- Right page -->
    <path d='M46 56 L66 60 L66 82 L46 78 Z' fill='#ffeec2' stroke='#e8c88a' stroke-width='1.5'/>
    <!-- Spine -->
    <line x1='46' y1='56' x2='46' y2='78' stroke='#c99a4e' stroke-width='2'/>
    <!-- Lines of text -->
    <line x1='30' y1='64' x2='42' y2='62' stroke='#c9a06a' stroke-width='1.2'/>
    <line x1='30' y1='68' x2='42' y2='66' stroke='#c9a06a' stroke-width='1.2'/>
    <line x1='30' y1='72' x2='42' y2='70' stroke='#c9a06a' stroke-width='1.2'/>
    <line x1='50' y1='62' x2='62' y2='64' stroke='#c9a06a' stroke-width='1.2'/>
    <line x1='50' y1='66' x2='62' y2='68' stroke='#c9a06a' stroke-width='1.2'/>
    <line x1='50' y1='70' x2='62' y2='72' stroke='#c9a06a' stroke-width='1.2'/>
  </g>
  <!-- Feet -->
  <ellipse cx='30' cy='92' rx='9' ry='5' fill='#3aaa4e'/>
  <ellipse cx='54' cy='92' rx='9' ry='5' fill='#3aaa4e'/>
  <!-- Toes -->
  <circle cx='24' cy='92' r='2.5' fill='#f5d442'/>
  <circle cx='30' cy='93' r='2.5' fill='#f5d442'/>
  <circle cx='36' cy='92' r='2.5' fill='#f5d442'/>
  <circle cx='48' cy='92' r='2.5' fill='#f5d442'/>
  <circle cx='54' cy='93' r='2.5' fill='#f5d442'/>
  <circle cx='60' cy='92' r='2.5' fill='#f5d442'/>
</svg>
